what: Literature-standard eVTOL energy model parameters, carried as boxes
cite: Kasliwal et al., 'Role of flying cars in sustainable mobility', Nature Communications 10:1555 (2019), Methods + Table 1; open access

eta_c.note: cruise chain, base 0.765 = 0.90 powertrain x 0.85 propulsive

rho.note: near-sea-level air density kg/m^3 (NYC/SP missions fly low)

usable_frac.note: usable share of nameplate, paper caps at 80% for cycle life

hover_budget_s.note: total hover across takeoff+landing; paper 2x30 s, widened for urban ops

mission_distance_pads.note: STATED ASSUMPTION: sampled ADS-B path undercounts true path (cut turns) - hi pad +8%; GPS jitter can overcount - lo pad -3%; lo additionally floored at the great-circle distance

calibration.note: the paper's own worked examples; the battery proves both fall inside our degenerate-box evaluation
